title: Corner Tower Mirrored in the Moat
notes: Late-afternoon sun warms the Northwest Corner Tower of the Forbidden City, its tiered golden roofs doubled in the still moat between rows of willows.
location: Northwest Corner Tower, Forbidden City, Beijing
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: The many-eaved corner tower of the Forbidden City, golden roofs over red walls, rises from the corner of a long stone wall and is mirrored almost perfectly in the calm blue moat, with willows lining both banks under a clear pale sky.
caption: Corner Tower Mirrored in the Moat
